description: Runs standard make in a selected project directory.
name: make-standard-build
promptTemplate:
Create and execute the following shell script with `skill_execute`, passing it as `content`. Use `{{project_directory}}` as the directory containing the Makefile.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="{{project_directory}}"
[ -n "$PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ "$PROJECT_DIR" != "{{project_directory}}" ] || { echo "Missing project_directory" >&2; exit 1; }
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
make -j"$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)"
```

Return the make output.
systemInstruction: Run standard make in the selected project directory.
